notes.title: Narborion Review by Old Man Mordaith
notes.notes:
[...] the wide variety of stats, skills, feats, and spells you can take allow for greatly varied characters from play-through to play-through. Combined with the free nature of the over world map and you have a game that gives a lot of control to the players. Again, when you enter an episode, be prepared to live with the choices you made, as there is little chance to revisit past choices, and when you come to decision points you are often deciding between two extremes. With this style of game, that is a understandable move, one I think the creators executed well. If anything, they gave me more choices than I was expecting, which I consider a good thing.

Read the full review here:

https://oldmanmordaith.com/2017/03/22/narborion-saga/

notes.title: Last Beta Test Completed!
notes.notes:
As the last beta test results are in, we're making some last-minute touches: fine-tuning the battles, refining the combat opponents and polishing some parts of the story elements.

We hope everyone will LOVE our game as much as we do... :)
